content.text:
I submitted **index 29 (Co 0.14 / Sb 0.86)** as the best composition. Its measured EQE was **0.0103%**, and all 3 merit measurements are now used.

| Index | Co : Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 19 | 0.34 : 0.66 (the CoSb₂O₆ ratio) | 0.00052 |
| 25 | 0.19 : 0.81 | 0.0100 |
| 29 | 0.14 : 0.86 | 0.0103 |

- **Starting point:** I measured index 19 first because it matches the known CoSb₂O₆ compound. It gave almost no signal.
- **Sb-rich end:** index 25 came in about 20× higher. Index 29, at the Sb-rich end of the library, was only slightly higher again, so EQE seems to level off there. The true best could sit anywhere between indices 25 and 29.
- **What wasn't checked:** the Co-rich half of the library (indices 0–18) was never measured. I didn't prioritize it because EQE fell as Co increased, but with only 3 measurements I can't rule out a separate high point there. I also didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I don't know which crystal structure is behind the higher EQE at the Sb-rich end.
